findings.statement: Round-4 F-2 is closed for the cases the spec names: SCN-VER-131 has no finding, and both parts of SCN-VER-135 have it. One overlap is still open. The spec says: "Когда исключение закрыто не gate `human-approval`, а одной из двух других причин, вывод SHALL содержать ... `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED`". It does not say what happens when the M^1 policy contains `human-approval` and the record of the Change at M^1 is also past `SPECIFIED`. This is the main recovery path in the design's risk "Слит не тем": a repeat impl-PR of a class Change whose record already carries the acceptance profile. The exit code and the ref outcome are the same under both readings. Only whether `data.findings[]` contains the finding differs.
findings.recommendation: State that the finding is emitted only when the policy is not computable, or when it is computed without `human-approval` and the record condition holds (no finding if the gate is present). Add this case to SCN-VER-135 or SCN-VER-131.

findings.statement: The fail-closed condition names "профиль `classification`, которого нет в packs M^1". Two other places list policy sources separately: "policy (packs, `.warrant/local/**`, конфигурация)" and "ни один объект policy базы (packs и `.warrant/local/**`)". Read literally, a local profile in `classification`, such as `human-acceptance` or a consumer's own local profile without `human-approval`, is "not in packs M^1", so the exception closes with `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED`. SCN-VER-129 uses "packs M^1" to include local profiles ("`classify` по packs M^1 выводит профиль приёмки"), so the intended reading is probably "policy objects of M^1". For a consumer local profile without `human-approval`, the two readings lead to different ref outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Write "профиль `classification`, которого нет в policy M^1 (packs и `.warrant/local/**`)", and use the same wording for "`classify` по packs M^1".

proposals.change: `AGENT_MERGE_CLOSED`: state the overlap case (gate `human-approval` present and record at M^1 past `SPECIFIED`: no finding). "packs M^1" becomes "policy M^1 (packs и `.warrant/local/**`)" in the fail-closed list and in the classification sentence.

assumptions.statement: Round-4 F-1, F-2 and F-3 and round-3 F-8 and F-9 are treated as closed. F-1: the exception holds only when the record at M^1 is absent or not past `SPECIFIED` (SCN-VER-135 is rewritten). F-2: the finding applies when the exception is closed by something other than the `human-approval` gate, whatever the ref outcome (SCN-VER-131: no finding). F-3: the INV-03 carve-out is "к которому применено исключение". F-8: the trust paragraph and design Goals give class paths in archive and none PRs to the forge only. F-9: agent identities for `MERGED` are those of M^1.

In honest SRA flow the record at M^1 is `SPECIFIED`: the spec-PR brings `SPECIFIED` into `main`, and the impl-PR brings `APPROVED`…`VERIFYING` (SCN-VER-090; record `identities`: the repeat #114 had base record `VERIFYING`). So the new record condition does not close the exception on an honest single impl-PR.

`approved_by` of a `WAIVED` on `MERGED` is checked against `roles` of the archive-PR base, not M^1. An impl-PR that edits `roles` or adds a waiver touches `.warrant/**`. That path is in the acceptance class and in `match.paths` of M^1, so the ref rule by M^1 already requires a human. For this reason no finding is made.
